definitions.gloss: to entertain, to host, to treat
definitions.explanation: To receive and treat a guest with hospitality, offering food, drink, or attentive service.

examples.japanese: {手料理|てりょうり}でもてなした。
examples.english: I treated them to a home-cooked meal.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}くから{来|き}た{友人|ゆうじん}を{心|こころ}を{込|こ}めてもてなした。
examples.english: I wholeheartedly entertained a friend who came from far away.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xをもてなす.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{客|きゃく}をもてなす (to entertain guests)
・{手料理|てりょうり}でもてなす (to treat with home cooking)
・{心|こころ}を{込|こ}めてもてなす (to host wholeheartedly)
・{温|あたた}かくもてなす (to give a warm welcome)

RELATED:
The noun form おもてなし is widely known from the phrase 「おもてなしの{心|こころ}」 (the spirit of hospitality). おもてなし became internationally known through the 2013 Tokyo Olympics bid presentation.
